notes.title: Patch 1.0.20 - Rerolls and Monster Passives
notes.notes:
Hi Delvers,

We've got the 2 main features hitting the game from our roadmap today - Rerolls and Monster passives, as well as a new mechanic for class actions! These features are focusing on giving you more control, and making the game more nuanced and difficult, and balancing some of the classes. Lets dive into the details and let you know what's been changed. 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Rerolls:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360451/fca87674cefd6f69332876dfaede237a678039db.jpg[/img]
Rerolls are used inside of the the Relic and Level up screens, and are used to generate a new reward. These rerolls are a limited resource in the run, so you'll have to choose carefully when you want to use them. You'll start off with 5 rerolls by default, but can find a reroll on each of the Delver Trees that you can unlock to add to your pool - so you'll end up with 20 rerolls if you unlock all of them. 

While unlocking relics and skills from the Delver trees gives you more options, it also dilutes your pools. Rerolls are a way to allow you to roll through what's coming out as rewards, and more easily control what you're picking up from a run.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Monster Passives:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360451/ba85ac09b3cd327e83f67ad5b681d546964e69b6.jpg[/img]
With how powerful Delvers are, firing off multiple moves in a turn, the monsters have been feeling a bit easy to handle up till now. The Monster passives are being introduced to bring the balance back into the monsters favour. 

The passives are super varied, and you'll have to load into the game to see, but we'll put a couple of examples to let you know how they work.
[list]
[*] Prey on the Weak - Scorpion Passive: When a Delver has a curse, the Scorpion gains +5 Damage on all Attacks.
[*] Unstable Mutation - Bruiser Passive: If the Bruiser is under 50% health it applies a Random Curse on every hit.
[*] Twisted Pair – Scorched Bruiser Passive: If a Flaming Blaster dies, then the Scorched Bruiser becomes Fortified for the rest of combat.
[*] Twisted Pair – Flaming Blaster Passive: If a Scorched Bruiser dies, then the Flaming Blaster gains +5 damage on attacks for the rest of combat
[/list]
Each Monster has their own passive either geared towards making them more dangerous or pairing them with other Monsters. We've really enjoyed making and testing this system, and we hope you all will like it as much! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Class Actions and Charges:[/h1]
We found that some of the class actions were really good (maybe too good), while some were a bit under utilised. We've added charges to some of the class actions to give us some more levers to help us balance them, making some more powerful without unbalancing the game.

Charges are a new resource that only regenerate between fights, and are a hard limit on the number of times you can cast a class action inside of one combat. Charges work per individual action, so they will only go down when you use that action, and only limit that action's use when you run out. 

[h2]Class Actions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Heal[/b]: now has 2 charges, but has the same effects as before
[*] [b]Rally[/b]: now has 3 charges, but has the same effects as before
[*] [b]Recover[/b]: Now has 2 charges, but has been buffed to only cost 2 AP to give 2 AP to another Delver
[*] [b]Guard[/b]: Has no charges, as it would remove too much control from the game
[*] [b]Cleave[/b]: Has no charges, as once 1 Monster is killed it becomes more efficient to use 2 attacks
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Quality of Life Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] We've added in functionality to show when a Monster Move have had its status effect duration changed
[*] We've brought in the positives and negatives to the skill trees 
[*] Minor lighting tweaks across the game
[*] Healthbars now sit more directly over the Delver's heads
[*] You can now see and use your spells by small icons next to your spellbook
[*] Monsters and Delvers now has a Type associated with them - Flying beast, Undead, Delver, etc. which some passives use
[*] We've tightened up some of the timings for Monster moves, making it more streamlined
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some runs had a empty/blank relic as a reward 
[*] Fixed an issue with some errors on ability descriptions
[*] Fixed an issue where hovering on the delver trees would bring up the wrong hover panels
[*] Fixed an issue on some of the spell descriptions
[*] Fixed an issue where is a Delver died to thorns, then the game would soft lock
[*] Fixed an issue where the Paladin's Mace relic was not stacking correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Corruption and Bug Fixing - Patch 1.0.12
notes.notes:
Hi Delvers,

We've changed the way corruption works, and have handled a couple more bugs and have done some tweaks and changes to some further UX improvements.

[h2]Corruption and Difficulty:[/h2]
We've changed the way corruption works, now treating it more as a difficulty setting that you can choose, rather than something that you have to grind for - there's more than enough of that on the Celestial Tablet. Here's the key changes to the system:
[list]
[*] All corruption levels are now unlocked from the start, and show the difficulty rating you have selected on the meter itself. 
[*] We've made the Corruption meter clearer by framing it as a difficulty bar which is always visible, but hovering over it brings up the details of what each level brings. 
[*] Your score multiplier still works in the same way, so playing at higher difficulties increases the score that you post on the leaderboard.
[*] You'll also still be increasing your the amount of Gold and Dungeon Resources that you gain by playing at higher Corruption levels, but now it's fully in your control how and when you want to scale the difficulty 
[/list]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]UX improvements[/h2] 
[list]
[*] We've added the spell icons around the spell button in the game - allowing you to see what's active, what's on cooldown, and select them by pressing the buttons.
[*] We've aligned the Healthbars to the tops of the Delver's heads.
[*] Changes to ability upgrades are done through Positive and Negative markers on the Celestial Tablet - replacing the long-form descriptions that we had previously. 
[/list]


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]Balance Tweaks:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We've changed Shiro's Breaking Shockwave to refund an AP if it does not Sunder a Monster 
[/list]
This change was suggested by a community member and we thought it really improved the way the ability felt and rewarded players for thinking about their action order more. Feel free to let us know what you're thinking on ways you'd like the game to improve.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some players were unable to progress to Act 2, Chapter 3 - The Duke.
[*] Fixed a type on Duke Ravensguards description
[*] Fixed Sepheris' Passive ability
[/list]

notes.title: Dungeonfell Patch 1.0.8 - On-Hover Events and Damage Clarifications
notes.notes:
Hi Delvers,

This week we're been focusing refining the initial experience based on the feedback you all have been leaving. This Friday we'll be posting a roadmap on the future of Dungeonfell, so stay tuned for more info. 
Today, however, we've got 2 tweaks to the game that have come from suggestions from the community in this patch. 

[h2]On-Hover Information:[/h2]
We've added in some context hovers to the game, so that you can more easily get information on what something means or how it works. We've focused on the parts of the game that were unclear or did not have a "click and hold" functionality to get more information.

[h3]Hover Locations:[/h3]
[list]
[] Health stat - clarifying what health it. We probably don't need this one, but it would feel strange if the other stats had this
[] Defence / stat - clarifying how Defence works and how a % chance to hit is calculated
[] Accuracy / stat - clarifying how Accuracy works and how a % chance to hit is calculated
[] Initiative / stat - clarifying what initiative is and how the +X number is generated. 
[] Abilities / Tree Nodes - saying how Ability upgrade work and the limitations on choosing an upgrade.
[] Stances / Tree Node - saying how Stance upgrade work and the limitations on choosing an upgrade.
[] Base Spell / Tree Node - saying what a Spell is and how it is used.
[] Spell Upgrade / Tree Node - saying how upgrading a Spell works. 
[] Relics / Tree Node - saying what a Relic is and how the relic pool works.
[] Upgrade Button / Spellbook - saying where the button in the spellbook takes you and why.
[/list]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]Berserk, Frenzy, and Weak Clarifications:[/h2]
We've also tweaked how Berserk, Frenzy, and Weak work - they now do what they say on the tin, rather than adding or removing a % of the base damage amount.
I'll do an example how how it worked and how it now works for clarification:

[h3]Old Maths:[/h3]
[olist]
[] In the old system, an attack that dealt [b]20[/b] damage and was given [b]Berserk (+50% Damage)[/b], it would go up to [b]30[/b]. 
[] If that attack then was given [b]Weak (-50% Damage)[/b], it would go back down to [b]20[/b]
[] So they would both basically cancel each other out, but you wouldn't actually be doing 50% less damage on the number shown on the attack (-15), it would 50% less damage of the starting damage (-10).
[] The above system caused some confusion, so we've moved over to a [b]"does what it says on the tin"[/b] system
[/olist]


[h3]New Maths:[/h3]
[olist]
[] In the old system, an attack that dealt [b]20[/b] damage and was given [b]Berserk (+50% Damage)[/b], it would go up to [b]30[/b]. 
[] So Far the Same
[] Now, however, if the attack was given Weak [b](-50% damage)[/b], it will reduce the number you see by 50% - reducing it to [b]15[/b]
[] They still cancel each other out, but now they work off of the number you see, rather than the number you would have to remember.
[/olist] 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]Balance Tweaks:[/h2]
[list]
[] Dahlia has [b]+1[/b] Accuracy, bringing her in line with Kaijin
[/list]


Bug Fixes: 
[list]
[] Fixed an issue where the game save when leaving a level would not handle ability cooldowns correctly 
[/list]

notes.title: Dungeonfell Patch 1.0.7 - Understanding Stats, Cooldowns, and Tactics
notes.notes:
Hi Delvers,

We've fixed a couple of bugs and added in some UX clarification to help better convey the stats of Monsters and Delvers, helping to make sense of the Delver level ups that effect your stats. We'll just dive into the stats and what they do quickly here before going over the main changes in this patch:

[h2]Stats:[/h2]
[list]
[] [b]Health[/b] - The amount of damage a Delver or Monster can take before they die
[] [b]Accuracy[/b] - Compared to the defence of the defender to determine a % change to hit
[] [b]Defence[/b] - Compared to the Accuracy of an attacker to  determine a % change to hit
[] [b]Initiative[/b] - The base number used to order Delvers and Monsters into the queue at the start of combat. A number is randomly generated per character, where the range is based off of the corruption level, and added at the start of combat to give slight variance, 
[/list]

[h2]Key Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[] Cooldown is now shown on the Ability info page.
[] Cooldown and Level are now shown on the Spell info page.
[] When inspecting a Delver inside of combat (Clicking and Holding on them or their Queue Icon), you can now inspect their action details and their current cooldowns.
[] We've added Delver stats to the Delver select screen and Monster/Delver stats to when you inspect a a character inside of a match.
[/list]


[h2]Balance Tweaks:[/h2]
[list]
[] [b]Breakers hammer has changed to affect only [b]One Delver[/b], instead of All all Delvers, but has reduced in rarity from Gold to [b]Silver[/b].[/b]
[/list]


[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[] Fixed an issue where your corruption level did not reset correctly when lowering the difficulty
[*] Fixed an issue where a revived Delver would run out of a room in the wrong direction
[/list]

notes.title: Dungeonfell Patch 1.0.6 - Tweaks to breaking, blocking, and unlocking corruption
notes.notes:
Hi Delvers,

We'd just like to give a quick shout out to all of the streams, videos, and discord messages that have gone up over the weekend! Your feedback is heard and we are excited to move forward with you all! Sharing your honest thoughts is amazingly helpful, it's triggered some ideas that we've been wanting to do and we'll be shouting those out as we get closer to releasing them to you all.

We've heard that everyone has been stomping through the Tombs and taking out Sepheris without much trouble, so we've been tinkering with some changes that will shift the balance across the game. 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]System Changes:[/h1]
- Corruption levels are now unlocked by progressing through the game and each dungeon starts at an increasing baseline
- Armour is now only removed at the end of a fight, rather than the start of your turn. This goes for Monsters and Delvers, so you'll have to find some new strats on how to deal with defensive Monsters.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Balance Tweaks:[/h1]
- As Monsters and Delvers no longer lose armour, the majority of Monster abilities that give armour have been tweaked
- You no longer gain team AP from winning a fight, it's just earned from breaking Monsters
- Heroes have 1 less defence, so they are 10% easier to hit
- Monsters with 3 BP have been buffed - this includes Bats, wraiths, and ghouls
- The Guard ability now gives the Monster a guaranteed hit against the Delver that Guards

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
- Fixed an issue where the camera would fly too far back when you left a room
- Fixed an issue where you would not get 3 relic choices
- Fixed an issue with Kaijin's Unlock ability - Warrior's Slash - did not grant team AP correctly
- Leaderboard tweaks to handle enormous scores
- Minor Tweaks to lighting in Pharaoh's Tomb Ruin Levels
- Fixed colour of Blasted Lands Crystal Resource Icon  to red instead of purple
- Fixed a couple of spelling errors in the story
- Fixed an issue where the Egyptian Monsters were reinforcing Undead Monsters
- Fixed an issue where the Stun PFX was not disappearing properly

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you want to talk to us directly jump in our [url=https://discord.gg/mrKRPZk6VZ]Discord[/url] and have a chat.

More to come so stay tuned!
